name: squeeze_floor_negative_is_legacy_passthrough
description: AC-1 edge: a negative squeeze_floor is the <=0 escape hatch (no clamp), NOT a rejected value and NOT a negative-distance floor. Byte-identical legacy squeezed value. (Negative is finite, so it must NOT trip the non-finite reject; it is simply an opt-out.)
derivation: pre_squeeze=0.30. active=0.30*0.5=0.15. squeeze_floor=-0.5 -> `squeeze_floor > 0` is False -> no clamp. Output 0.15 (unchanged); a negative floor never places or lifts the stop.
